records.title: Intensive First-Year Norwegian
records.text: NORW 150 Intensive First-Year Norwegian (15) Fundamentals of oral and written Norwegian. Intensive practice in speaking, reading, and writing. Interactive classroom, computer-assisted learning, language and reading laboratories. Emphasis on contemporary Norwegian culture and society. If Norwegian is the student's language of admission, only 10 credits count towards graduation. Maximum 15 credits allowed between NORW 101; NORW 102; NORW 103; and NORW 150.
